hook: Tolichowki kitchen fire climbed to the *6th* floor next door
hook_b: Tolichowki kitchen fire climbed to the *6th* floor next door
tldr: A fire that started in Mandi King restaurant's kitchen chimney in Tolichowki around midnight on Sunday spread to the neighbouring Hotel Zunera.

beats.what: The blaze began in the second-floor kitchen chimney of Mandi King between 11 pm and midnight, then reached Zunera's fourth and fifth floors.
beats.why: Thick smoke engulfed several floors; flames were reported up to the sixth floor.
beats.care: The cause and extent of damage have not yet been determined, Telangana Today reports.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Fire started between 11 pm and midnight Sunday in a 2nd-floor kitchen chimney and spread to the hotel next door.

cards.q: When you eat at a multi-floor restaurant, do you notice the fire exits?

qs: Who checks fire safety in kitchens of multi-storey restaurants?
How quickly can a chimney fire jump to the building next door?

facts.t: *No casualties* were reported; staff evacuated customers through emergency exits.

viz.verdict: Two buildings hit; no one hurt

watch: Officials are yet to state the cause and the extent of damage.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Hyderabad: Fire at Mandi King spreads to neighbouring Hotel Zunera in Tolichowki

fact: A Tolichowki restaurant chimney fire spread up to the *6th* floor of the next hotel.
twist: Several customers were inside; staff got them out through emergency exits and moved gas cylinders away. No casualties.
